output:
I'll start by reading the docs and looking at the data.

The last call was malformed and didn't run. I'm now writing the script with `write_file`.

The script is at `/app/bin/payroll.py`, and its result for `/app/data` is saved at `/app/out/payroll.json`. I ran `python3 tools/check_payroll.py`, and it printed "OK: every value matches the approved figures." All 150 employees match on every field, and so do the exceptions and totals. The run takes about 0.25 seconds.

The script follows the documented rules rather than anything specific to this period's files. It uses only the standard library, and it reads gzip-compressed files by their first two bytes whatever their names.

For this period it reports 131 open shifts, 78 orphan outs, 278 dropped duplicates and 279 applied corrections. Total gross is 1,138,755.89.

I also wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

I couldn't test two cases because this data doesn't contain them. One is the same punch id arriving in two files with different values. The script keeps the first one it reads, since the docs only say a punch can be delivered more than once. The other is an employee with no rate on or before a shift's workday, which the script pays at 0.00.

command_result.command: cd /app; find . -type f | head -100; cat docs/*.md
cd /app; sed -n 60,400p docs/exports.md; echo ======; sed -n 1,40p docs/output.md

cd /app; ls data data/exports data/corrections; cat data/sites.csv data/period.json; head -5 data/employees.csv data/rates.csv; cat tools/check_payroll.py | head -80; head -c 600 tools/reference-digests.json

cd /app/data; for s in exports/*; do echo "=== $s"; ls $s | wc -l; f=$(ls $s | head -3 | tail -1); head -c 700 $s/$f; echo; done; head -5 corrections/batch-1.csv; cat corrections/*.csv | wc -l; for f in $(find exports -type f); do head -c2 $f | xxd -p | grep -q 1f8b && echo GZ $f; done | head; ls exports/*/ | grep -v -E '^(punches-)?2026-..-..\.csv$' | head

cd /app; python3 -V; ls /usr/share/zoneinfo | head -3; python3 -c "import zoneinfo;print(zoneinfo.ZoneInfo('Asia/Kathmandu'))"; sed -n 80,200p tools/check_payroll.py; wc -l data/employees.csv data/rates.csv; cut -d, -f3 data/rates.csv | sort | head -3; python3 - <<'E'
import gzip,glob
n=0
for f in glob.glob('/app/data/**/*',recursive=True):
    import os
    if os.path.isfile(f) and open(f,'rb').read(2)==b'\x1f\x8b': n+=1;print(f)
print(n)
E

cd /app; mkdir -p out; time python3 bin/payroll.py data out/payroll.json && python3 tools/check_payroll.py; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('out/payroll.json'));print(d['exceptions'],d['totals'])"

cd /app; echo '{"status":"success","summary":"Wrote /app/bin/payroll.py (stdlib only) implementing the documented formats and rules, ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/payroll.json; tools/check_payroll.py reports every value matching the approved figures."}' > STATUS.json; cat STATUS.json
